exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Signing Up for the Exchange
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Hi, Mei. I heard you signed up for the exchange programme to the UK.

transcript.speaker: Mei
transcript.text: Yes! I want to learn about global business and improve my English.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: That's great. But aren't you worried about the cost?

transcript.speaker: Mei
transcript.text: A little. Tuition and living expenses are high, so I made a careful budget.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Smart. Will you live in a dormitory or with a host family?

transcript.speaker: Mei
transcript.text: A host family. They can help me adapt and comfort me when I miss home.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Good idea. What's your biggest goal for the year?

transcript.speaker: Mei
transcript.text: To set up my own business in China one day. This is the first step.

exercises.translation_cn: Tom 听说梅报名了去英国的交换项目;梅想学全球商业并提高英语;Tom 担心费用;梅说学费生活费高,所以做了仔细的预算;她选住寄宿家庭,能帮她适应、想家时给安慰;她最大的目标是将来在中国创业,这是第一步。

questions.stem: Why did Mei sign up for the exchange programme?
options: To learn about global business and improve her English.

questions.stem: What is Tom worried about?
How did Mei deal with the high expenses?
Why does Mei choose a host family?
options: Because they can help her adapt and comfort her.

questions.stem: What is Mei's biggest goal for the year?
options: To stay in the UK forever.
To start her own business in China one day.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 Studying Abroad Today
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: In recent years, more and more young people choose to study abroad.
They hope to gain a global perspective and improve their general competence.
However, studying overseas can also bring tremendous pressure.
Some students suffer from culture shock in unfamiliar surroundings.
With careful planning, though, the experience can change them for the better.
exercises.translation_cn: 近年来,越来越多的年轻人选择出国留学;他们希望获得全球视野、提升综合能力;然而出国也会带来巨大压力;一些学生在陌生环境中遭遇文化冲击;不过若计划周全,这段经历能让他们变得更好。

questions.stem: What is happening with young people and studying abroad?
options: Fewer of them want to study at all.
None of them go overseas now.
More and more of them choose to study abroad.

questions.stem: What do these students hope to gain?
options: A global perspective and better competence.
An easier life with no work.

questions.stem: What problem can studying overseas bring?
What do some students suffer from in new surroundings?
What can make the experience change them for the better?

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Interview at the Confucius Institute
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Welcome, Aisha. Thanks for joining us today.

transcript.speaker: Aisha
transcript.text: Thank you. It's a pleasure to be here.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: What made you feel close to your teacher, Ms Hu?

transcript.speaker: Aisha
transcript.text: She often invited us to her home for meals, so I felt like family.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Lovely. Why did you decide to become a teacher yourself?

transcript.speaker: Aisha
transcript.text: I wanted to share that same warmth with new learners of Chinese.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: And why do your students see Chinese as useful?

transcript.speaker: Aisha
transcript.text: Because more jobs now need people who can connect China with the world.

exercises.translation_cn: 主持人欢迎 Aisha 并感谢她到来;Aisha 表示很高兴;主持人问是什么让她与胡老师亲近;Aisha 说老师常请他们到家里吃饭,让她有家的感觉;她想把同样的温暖分享给新的中文学习者;她的学生认为中文有用,因为越来越多的工作需要能连接中国与世界的人。

questions.stem: What made Aisha feel like part of Ms Hu's family?
Why did Aisha become a teacher?
options: To share the same warmth with new learners.

questions.stem: Why do her students think Chinese is useful?
options: Because it is easy to write.
Because more jobs need people who connect China with the world.

questions.stem: How does the host begin the interview?
options: By welcoming Aisha and thanking her.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 A Tip on Weak Forms
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a useful tip for learners who find fast English hard to follow.
English is a stress-based language, so some words are not stressed.
Small words like pronouns and prepositions often use a weak form.
For example, in 'Are you ready?', 'are' and 'you' sound very light.
If you learn the weak forms, you will understand native speakers more easily.
exercises.translation_cn: 给觉得快速英语难懂的学习者一个有用的小贴士:英语是重音语言,有些词不重读;代词、介词等小词常用弱读形式;例如在“Are you ready?”中,are 和 you 读得很轻;学会弱读形式,你就能更容易听懂母语者。

questions.stem: Who is this tip for?
options: Learners who find fast English hard to follow.
People who never listen to English.

questions.stem: What kind of language is English, according to the passage?
Which words often use a weak form?
options: Small words like pronouns and prepositions.

questions.stem: What happens to 'are' and 'you' in 'Are you ready?'
What is the benefit of learning weak forms?
options: You understand native speakers more easily.
You will speak like a robot.

exercises.title: U2 听力·对话 Advice on Fitting In
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Liu
transcript.text: I've been here a month, but I still feel like an outsider. Any advice?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: That's normal at first. The best cure is to get involved in activities.

transcript.speaker: Liu
transcript.text: Really? I usually just stay in my room and study.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Try joining a club or a sports team. You'll soon make new friends.

transcript.speaker: Liu
transcript.text: But my English isn't perfect. I'm afraid of making mistakes.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Don't worry about mistakes. Every one is a chance to learn.

transcript.speaker: Liu
transcript.text: That makes sense. I'll be braver and speak up more.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Exactly. Step out of your comfort zone, and you'll feel at home soon.

exercises.translation_cn: 刘来这里一个月仍觉得自己像局外人,向 Anna 求建议;Anna 说一开始很正常,最好的办法是参与活动;刘平时只待在房间里学习;Anna 建议加入社团或球队,很快会交到新朋友;刘担心英语不完美、怕犯错;Anna 说别担心犯错,每个错误都是学习的机会;刘决定更勇敢、多开口;Anna 鼓励他走出舒适区,很快就会有家的感觉。

questions.stem: How does Liu feel after a month abroad?

options: He stays in his room and studies.

questions.stem: What does Anna say about making mistakes?
options: Every one is a chance to learn.

questions.stem: What does Liu decide to do?
options: To stay in his room longer.
To be braver and speak up more.

exercises.title: U2 听力·短文 Becoming a Cultural Envoy
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: When you study in another country, you do more than attend classes.
You become a kind of cultural envoy for your homeland.
By sharing your food, music and stories, you help others understand it.
At the same time, you learn to see the world from new angles.
In this way, each student helps to build a bridge between nations.
exercises.translation_cn: 当你在另一个国家学习时,你做的不只是上课;你成了祖国的一种文化使者;通过分享你的食物、音乐和故事,你帮助别人理解它;与此同时,你学会从新的角度看世界;这样,每个学生都在为各国之间架起一座桥梁。

questions.stem: What do you do besides attending classes when studying abroad?
options: You become a cultural envoy for your homeland.

questions.stem: How do you help others understand your homeland?
options: By sharing your food, music and stories.

questions.stem: What do you learn to do at the same time?
options: To see the world from new angles.

questions.stem: What does each student help to build, according to the passage?
What is the main message of the passage?
options: Studying abroad is a waste of time.
Students should never share their culture.
Only teachers can be cultural envoys.
Studying abroad can make you a bridge between cultures.
